raw_leaf_reference_policy: Actual case reference fields remain null when undeclared. Related context lives in its own binding and never becomes an exact state reference or pixel oracle.
image_open_count_policy: Open every mandatory actual unique path independently. A legitimately shared exact path has one actual opening with covered-case bindings; equal SHA across different paths gives no reuse credit.
model_selection: Intentional inheritance because current tool metadata does not distinguish model capabilities.
requirements: Open every mandatory actual unique current and related-context path; lawful same-path sharing requires covered-case bindings. Equal SHA across distinct paths cannot replace openings. Count all design and source composition pairs together within four total pairs and eight required opens.

For F13, read each own Scribe column 0 through 5 or PW column 0 through 2 independently. Require the complete fitting unit/status, actual author allocation and separator. Optional author text with oversized subtitle remains optional. Seeds have zero image and primary ownership credit.

For F11, read the own before-open, every actual modal page and after-close originals, including both supplement PW page ends, folio, close affordance and return to Downloads. Main one-page and supplement two-page PW captures have independent run/module namespaces. Shared Scribe Download context is related only, not an exact modal reference or PW pixel oracle.

Preserve raw null reference, capability, closed/source and operation fields. Source payload, allocations, automatic PASS, old P1 images or observations cannot replace actual new glyph, purity or closing-operation observations. Typeface and weights 500/700 remain unmeasured limitations.

Required unread text or uncertain extents require precise own-source ROI and reading_pending; this worker does not create or process ROI images. Required issues block closure and non-required optimizations remain deferred.

Assigned worker may read static text and use tools.view_image only for the planned originals. No SSH, hashing, tests, builds, validation, probes, App/capture, Python/PIL, crop/resize/image processing, extra images, child agents, Source or registry edits.

Write a new compact English report at report_path and use Chinese team messages. Record actual actor/parent/proxy/slot, path-role-SHA openings, reference/source/total pairs and new_required/reading_pending/identity/deferred. No hidden, hardware, unobserved operation, package, full-stress or global clean credit.
declared_hash_basis: Actual independent pass2 snapshot.members plus the actual owner-release module SHA and after-identity declarations. The owner-release SHA is supplied by the sole coordinator; no local or Source hashing.
